metadata.sourceProject: Apache Kafka (KAFKA) public Jira issue metadata, fetched via the Jira REST API
metadata.license: Apache Software Foundation public project data; the Apache Kafka project is Apache-2.0 and its Jira tracker is public. Attribution: derived from issues.apache.org Jira, project KAFKA. Not endorsed by the ASF.
metadata.transform: Kept only structure from a 12-month slice (open issues plus issues resolved in the last 60 days): who commented or was assigned and when. Comment text is dropped entirely. People are replaced by generated fictional names (deterministic mapping, no source name reused); the long tail of commenters is folded into 3 'Community contributor' accounts; bot accounts become one 'Build Bot'. Titles are generated from templates. Issue keys are renumbered. Timestamps are stored as millisecond offsets from the latest activity (0 = now, negative = past), rounded to the hour, and rebased to Date.now() by loadSample. The source cache had no reporter, component, priority, due date or link data, so areas, priorities, due dates and links/blocks are synthetic.
metadata.syntheticDisclosure: Goals, teams, areas, priorities, due dates, links and blocks, loads, the two on-leave people and the owner edges on goals are synthetic. Assigned-edge times are set to just after the issue was created because the cache has no assignment history. 'authored' edges do not exist because the cache has no reporter field. Roles of the three leavers are labels chosen from comment behaviour, not real job titles.

measuredNotAssignedShare.definition: open work items where the leaver holds >=50% of human comment/review contributions and is not the assignee, over all open items where they hold >=50%
measuredNotAssignedShare.selectionNote: The engineer leaver was picked as the most-assigned person with >=75% of main-voice items unassigned, so the leaver figure is selected, not a population estimate.
